systemic_engineering_uplift.name: public_copy_transformation
systemic_engineering_uplift.problem: Internal decision-job tokens and generic validation copy leak into public UI.
systemic_engineering_uplift.engine_must: Transform frozen scene intent + company truth + verified evidence into public proposition, section headline, support copy, proof copy and CTA microcopy; prohibit internal labels in rendered copy.

systemic_engineering_uplift.name: hero_authority_authorship
systemic_engineering_uplift.problem: Hero varies structurally but does not consistently establish a company-specific premium reason-to-believe.
systemic_engineering_uplift.engine_must: Compose Hero from Family + decision state + strongest verified authority + media roles without mapping Family to one Hero.

systemic_engineering_uplift.name: scene_dramaturgy_and_density
systemic_engineering_uplift.problem: Page rhythm remains repeated stacked blocks with uniform spacing and hierarchy.
systemic_engineering_uplift.engine_must: Author per-scene weight, density, width, media/text relationship, chapter transition, proof adjacency and mobile recomposition.

systemic_engineering_uplift.name: media_story_binding
systemic_engineering_uplift.problem: Images are rights-safe but weakly participate in persuasion.
systemic_engineering_uplift.engine_must: Bind each asset to authority/process/context/detail/outcome function, claim adjacency, crop intent, caption/provenance mode and sequence role.

systemic_engineering_uplift.name: proof_choreography
systemic_engineering_uplift.problem: Trust/proof remains a generic block instead of decisive evidence staging.
systemic_engineering_uplift.engine_must: Place verified proof at the objection or claim it resolves; never promote illustrative media to factual evidence.

systemic_engineering_uplift.name: cta_choreography
systemic_engineering_uplift.problem: Stage A has no actionable CTA links and closing strategy is metadata-like.
systemic_engineering_uplift.engine_must: Render verified-destination CTAs with pre-CTA reassurance, primary/secondary hierarchy and decision-stage-specific wording.

systemic_engineering_uplift.name: meaningful_motion
systemic_engineering_uplift.engine_must: Allow motion only when it clarifies hierarchy, sequence, comparison or feedback and always provide reduced-motion behavior.

systemic_engineering_uplift.name: family_company_visual_voice
systemic_engineering_uplift.problem: All samples use the same visible CSS expression, increasing template smell.
systemic_engineering_uplift.engine_must: Derive type relationship, measure, spacing cadence, rule treatment, image geometry and surface depth from Family + company truth + scene plan while retaining a shared engineering system.

systemic_engineering_uplift.name: mobile_premium_recomposition
systemic_engineering_uplift.problem: Mobile is safe but mostly a vertical collapse.
systemic_engineering_uplift.engine_must: Re-author media order, proof adjacency, text measure, CTA behavior and chapter pacing at 320-430 without changing the persuasive job.

client_evidence_dependencies.cannot_be_replaced_by: generic outcome image presented as result

boundary_rules: Systemic uplift must improve composition/copy/media choreography even when client evidence is sparse.
Missing client evidence must be surfaced transparently and must never trigger fabricated proof.
Client evidence availability must not switch Creative Family.
Generic stock may create atmosphere/context but remains illustrative unless provenance proves actual-company evidence.
